Single-file libraries, copied unchanged (each carries its own licence at its end:
public domain, or MIT / MIT-0, whichever you prefer).

dr_mp3.h, dr_flac.h, dr_wav.h
    https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs at f12e197fd462e4c22873fbd70d11b1d2f2c1dc3c
stb_truetype.h, stb_vorbis.c
    https://github.com/nothings/stb at 4e9b368bfc071e97206ea5c6adba68dd0cbf8897

Used where Windows' own is not there (Linux, and Wine without Windows' fonts):
stb_truetype draws the menus' text with the fonts in fonts/ (text.c), and the others
decode replacement music files (music.c).
